subject: G20 8d45038 demo, fakeFetch body swapped for the oracle transport (Grok adapter)

interaction_proof.title: initial state: input, results container, pre-existing live region, Solaris branding, no errors
typing issues a request and shows a loading state while it is pending
success renders the returned items and clears loading
empty response shows and announces an empty state
server error: announced, loading cleared, recoverable, error cleared on later success
out-of-order success: the late response for the older query never replaces the newer one

detail.requests: fewer than 2 (cannot exercise; debounce or no requests)

interaction_proof.title: out-of-order failure: a late error for the older query does not show an error over fresh results
keyboard: Tab reaches the input and a save control, no trap, visible focus indicator
failed save via keyboard: error announced, focus kept, item not marked saved, control usable again
retry save via keyboard after a failure succeeds and is announced
focus recovery: results re-render while focus is on a result control; focus is not dropped
narrow 360px: no horizontal overflow, input and save controls inside the viewport
wide 1280px: no horizontal overflow, input and save controls inside the viewport
three overlapping requests resolved 3,1,2: only the newest is ever shown after it lands
same query text twice (so, sol, so): the older 'so' response arriving last is still stale

detail.note: cannot exercise (cache or coalescing); inspect manually

interaction_proof.title: input cleared while requests are pending: late responses do not repopulate results
malformed JSON on 200: error state, no uncaught exception, not an empty state
markup in a returned label is rendered as text (no injected element or handler)
slow response (4 s): loading stays indicated, no premature empty or error state
320px reflow (WCAG 1.4.10 width): no horizontal overflow
double Enter on a pending save sends one request (or the control is disabled while pending)
network failure (fetch rejects) on search: error announced, no uncaught rejection
